idea-plugin.name: Git Untrack
idea-plugin.description:
Removes files from the Git index while keeping them on disk. Adds an Untrack action to the Git menus that runs git rm --cached on the selection, so the next commit deletes the files from the repository.
  • Folders are untracked recursively; unversioned and ignored files are skipped.
  • Works across several repositories at once.
  • Files with partially staged changes can be force untracked.
  • Undo from the notification.
Nothing is committed automatically.

action.description: Remove the selected files from the Git index and keep them on disk
